select-join-group.sql: SELECT "a"."name", COUNT("e"."id") AS "events" FROM "app"."account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a"."id" = "e"."account_id" WHERE "a"."active" = $1 AND ("e"."kind" = $2 OR "e"."id" IS NULL) GROUP BY "a"."name" HAVING COUNT("e"."id") > $3 ORDER BY COUNT("e"."id") DESC NULLS LAST, "a"."name" ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5

joins-every-kind.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" INNER JOIN "u" ON "t"."a" = "u"."a" RIGHT JOIN "s"."v" ON "s"."v"."b" > $1 FULL OUTER JOIN "w" ON FALSE CROSS JOIN "x"

operators.sql: SELECT ("a" + $1) * $2, "b" || $3, "c" % $4, ("d" / $5) - $6, ("e" <> "f" AND "g" <= $7) OR (NOT "h" >= $8), "i" IS DISTINCT FROM $9, "j" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $10

membership.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" WHERE $1 = $2 AND $3 = $4 AND "id" IN ($5, $6) AND "kind" NOT IN ($7) AND ("a", "b") IN (($8, $9)) AND "id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "u") AND "id" NOT IN (SELECT "id" FROM "v")

between.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" WHERE ("a" BETWEEN $1 AND $2) AND ("b" NOT BETWEEN $3 AND $4) AND ("c" BETWEEN SYMMETRIC $5 AND $6) AND ("d" NOT BETWEEN SYMMETRIC $7 AND $8)

patterns.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" WHERE "a" LIKE $1 OR "b" NOT LIKE $2 ESCAPE E'\\' OR ("c" ILIKE $3) OR ("d" NOT ILIKE $4 ESCAPE '!') OR STARTS_WITH("e", $5) OR "right"("f", CHAR_LENGTH($6)) = $7 OR strpos("g", $8) > 0

casts-collations-subscripts.sql: SELECT CAST("a" AS integer), CAST("b" AS app."Mood"[]), CAST($1::text AS interval), ("c" COLLATE "C"), ("d" COLLATE "pg_catalog"."de-x-icu"), "e"[$2], "f"[$3][$4], "g"[$5:$6], "h"[:$7], "i"[$8:], "j"[:]

case.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN ("x" > $1) THEN $2 WHEN ("x" < $3 AND "y" IS NOT NULL) THEN $4 END), (CASE WHEN ("x" IS NULL) THEN $5 ELSE "x" END) AS "filled", (CASE "kind" WHEN $6 THEN $7 WHEN $8 THEN $9 END), (CASE "kind" WHEN $10 THEN $11 ELSE $12 END)

values.sql: SELECT $1 + $2, CAST($3::text AS app.mood), CAST($4::text[] AS mood[]), $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10

functions.sql: SELECT LOWER("a"), UPPER("a"), ABS("b"), CHAR_LENGTH("a"), COUNT(DISTINCT "a"), SUM("b"), AVG("b"), MIN("b"), MAX("b"), ROUND("b"), ROUND("b", $1), COALESCE("a", $2), RANDOM(), GEN_RANDOM_UUID(), UUIDV4(), UUIDV7(), UUIDV7(CAST($3::text AS interval)), UUID_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP("u"), UUID_EXTRACT_VERSION("u")

subqueries.sql: SELECT "a"."id", (SELECT MAX("at") FROM "event") AS "last" FROM "app"."account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "id", "at" FROM "event" WHERE "event"."account" = "a"."id") AS "l" ON TRUE WHERE EXISTS(SELECT $1 FROM "flag" WHERE "account" = "a"."id")

from-subquery.sql: SELECT "sub"."id", "sub".* FROM (SELECT "id", "kind" FROM "t" WHERE "kind" <> $1) AS "sub" CROSS JOIN "u"

set-operations.sql: SELECT "id" FROM "t" UNION (SELECT "id" FROM "u") UNION ALL (SELECT "id" FROM "v") INTERSECT (SELECT "id" FROM "w") INTERSECT ALL (SELECT "id" FROM "x") EXCEPT (SELECT "id" FROM "y") EXCEPT ALL (SELECT "id" FROM "z")

locks.sql: SELECT * FROM "app"."account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a"."id" = "e"."account_id" FOR UPDATE OF "a" SKIP LOCKED

lock-share.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" FOR KEY SHARE NOWAIT

with.sql: WITH "recent" ("id") AS  MATERIALIZED (SELECT "id" FROM "t" WHERE "at" > $1) , "older" AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT "id" FROM "recent") SELECT * FROM "older"

with-recursive.sql: WITH RECURSIVE "r" ("n") AS (SELECT $1 AS "n" UNION ALL (SELECT "n" + $2 FROM "r" WHERE "n" < $3)) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY "n" SET "ord" CYCLE "n" SET "looped" USING "path" SELECT "n" FROM "r"

conditions.sql: SELECT * FROM "t" WHERE FALSE AND ("b" = $1 OR "c" = $2 OR ("d" = $3 AND "e" = $4)) HAVING NOT "a" = $5

condition-inspect.sql: SELECT TRUE WHERE "a" = $1 OR "b" IS NULL
